notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.24.3
HDR Composition is new: build one linear frame from two or more aligned exposures of the same filter, so a shorter exposure rebuilds the star cores the long one blew out. The scale between frames is measured from the pixels that are unsaturated in both, you can add the views in any order because it works out which is longest itself, and the result stays linear and inside 0-1. Mosaic Master can now crop and flatten every panel before aligning, and sends unsolved panels to the in-house Gaia blind solver first with Astrometry.net only as a fallback. Rotate is now a live drag-the-image preview with a ring handle, whole degrees by default, showing the output size before you commit. Very large images are much faster to work with: with a drizzled 2x master open, switching views or collapsing a dock rail took about five seconds and now takes about sixty milliseconds. Blink Comparator metrics moved onto every core, a 96-frame set measuring in about six seconds where it took over a minute, and the stacking measurement phase is about 2.4x faster. The Gaussian drizzle kernel's width now tracks drop shrink and shows its FWHM. Fixes: dragging SRGC after closing an image failed with wrapped C/C++ object of type QLabel has been deleted, SRGC Fetch Reference raised a TypeError, SRGC no longer reports surveys as moved when CDS is merely answering as a stub, AstroBin export falls back to the ambient temperature when a focuser reports -127, and opening a documentation page no longer floods the terminal. See the release notes for the full list.
